variables.name: other_asset_type_code
variables.description: Fixed literal used to scope the Other Asset Register screen (fam_other_asset_register) to FAM_ASSET_REGISTER rows where ASSET_TYPE = 'OTHER_ASSET' via row_security. Also auto-stamps ASSET_TYPE = 'OTHER_ASSET' on every row added through that screen, so it can never create a FIXED_ASSET row.
